CaS USER GUIDE

Customer & Store Dashboard

A simple guide to help you open CaS, understand your dashboard, review stores and customers within your access scope, search for information, and export the data you need.

StoresView active stores and bindings
CustomersReview customer coverage
ExcelExport your available data
00
Quick Start

How to Use CaS

  • Open CaS: Launch the app from Dingtalk Workbench. Your Dingtalk account is used to sign you in automatically through SSO.
  • Check your summary: Review the three summary cards to understand the number of active stores, customers, and active bindings within your access scope.
  • Review stores: Select Stores to view store counts and active bindings by district.
  • Review customers: Select Customers to view customer counts and customer-store counts by district.
  • Search: Use the search box when you need to locate a specific store, customer, district, region, sub-region, or other available hierarchy information.
  • Export: Select the download button when you need an Excel copy of the information available in your current view.
  • Refresh: If you want to check the latest available information, use the refresh button in the dashboard.
01
Overview

Customer & Store Dashboard

  • CaS gives you a single view of the stores and customers covered by your assigned access scope.
  • It also shows the current active store bindings, including Promoters, New Hire Trainees, and Frontliners.
02
Getting Started

Navigation

  • Open Dingtalk Workbench and select the Customer and Store Dashboard (CaS) app from your available applications.
  • When opened through Dingtalk, CaS uses Single Sign-On (SSO), so you do not need to enter your CaS username and password separately.
03
At a Glance

Summary of Active Stores, Customers and Binding

  • The summary cards at the top of the dashboard give you a quick view of Active Stores, Active Customers, and Active Bindings (Promoter/New Hire Trainee/Frontliner).
04
Store & Customer Tab

Store Tab

  • Select the Stores tab to view the stores included in your access scope, organized by district.
  • Each district shows its Active Store Count and Active Binding count. The Total Active row provides the overall count for your current view.
05
Store & Customer Tab

Customer Tab

  • Select the Customers tab to view customers included in your access scope, organized by district.
  • Each district shows the Active Customer Count and Active Customer Store Count. The Total Active row provides the overall count for your current view.
06
Find Information

Search Tab

  • Use the Search field to quickly find information such as HQ, district, region, sub-region, store, or customer. Enter part of the name or location you want to find and the dashboard will narrow the displayed results.
07
Data Export

Export Data in Excel

  • Select the download button to export the information available to you into an Excel file. The exported file follows your current access scope, so you only receive the data you are authorized to view.

User tip: Your dashboard is based on your assigned access scope. If you cannot see a store, customer, or organizational area, it may not be included in the scope assigned to your account.
